tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open AI training jobs (rating, writing and reviewing AI output, paid by AI labs) across vetted platforms. Filter by field, country, minimum hourly pay, platform, language and kind of data work. Returns each job with stated pay, who can apply and a url to its page (where the person applies).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job: pay, who can apply, how the platform screens applicants, and the description. Pass the job url or slug from search_jobs.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: Every platform listed, with open jobs, median top hourly rate, beginner-friendly roles and a one-line description. Use get_platform for how to get accepted and how it pays.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: One platform in depth: how its screening works, tips, how and when it pays (from its own help pages, with sources), its official domain for spotting fakes, live job counts, pay and fields.

tools.name: pay_stats
tools.description: What AI training jobs pay, from live listings that state an hourly rate: 25th percentile, median, 75th and 90th percentile of top rates, with the platforms hiring most. Optionally for one field and/or one country (listings that name the country or say worldwide).
